Drugs.Name: Atazanavir
Drugs.Effect: Increases HDL-C and decreases LDL-C levels

Drugs.Name: Abacavir
Drugs.Effect: Increases total cholesterol, LDL-C, and HDL-C levels

Drugs.Name: Lamivudine
Drugs.Effect: Increases total cholesterol, LDL-C, and HDL-C levels

Drugs.Name: Efavirenz
Drugs.Effect: Increases total cholesterol, LDL-C, HDL-C, and triglyceride levels

content.Excess Cardiovascular Risk: Excess cardiovascular risk in patients with HIV may be due to side effects from antiretroviral therapy affecting lipid levels.
content.Recommendations: Switch from abacavir due to increased cardiovascular events risk.
content.Drug Interactions: Interactions with protease inhibitors and statins can increase levels of the latter, increasing rhabdomyolysis risk.
